profile.purpose: panic perception at a single irreversible interruption

fixture.context: A previously syntactically normal scene reaches the instant the focal character recognizes an incoming train cannot stop.
fixture.text:
The signal stayed red. The brakes screamed once.

Too close.

No room.

Then the crossing gate vanished under the engine.

rubric: Accept deliberate fragments when an explicit profile permits them and each fragment belongs to a real perceptual/irreversible interruption rather than generic pseudo-pace.
Framework Fundamentals are mechanism rules, not a blanket ban on short sentences.
